# Natural Ice (Natural Ice Industry LLC)

> Natural Ice is an ice factory in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, UAE. It produces purified, food-grade ice 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and delivers with its own refrigerated trucks to all 7 emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi (including Al Ain), Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah.

## Key facts

- Arabic name: الثلج الطبيعي
- Type: ice manufacturer and ice delivery company (factory-direct)
- Location: Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Opening hours: 24/7, including weekends and public holidays
- Delivery: all 7 emirates; same-day delivery in Dubai; scheduled daily supply for businesses
- Products: ice cubes, tube ice, crushed ice, flake ice, 25 kg ice blocks, clear ice, flavoured ice balls, dry ice, custom logo ice
- Customers: hotels, restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, caterers, event organisers, construction sites, fisheries, farms and households
- Ordering: online at https://naturalice.ae/order or WhatsApp/phone +971 56 533 4189
- Google rating: 4.4 out of 5 from 49 reviews (October 2026)
- Certificates:
  - ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management System, scope "Manufacturing and Distribution of Ice" (certificate CQ25-1111, valid until 11 July 2028)
  - HACCP (Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969), certified since 2022 (certificate CQ25-1110, valid until 11 July 2028)
  - Emirates Quality Mark (EQM) for ice for human consumption, 1 kg and 2 kg tube ice, standard UAE.S GSO 384:2021, issued by a notified body of the UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (valid until 16 July 2028)
- Daily capacity: 1,000 tonnes of ice per day

## Prices (from)

- Block ice 25 kg: AED 20
- Tube ice 10 kg: AED 20
- Crushed ice 10 kg: AED 25
- Dry ice: AED 25 per kg
